name: Daisen by the Natsuyama trail
why: Steps up through beech forest to the summit plateau of the 'Fuji of Hoki', with the Sea of Japan and the Shimane peninsula below.
book: Free. Bus from Yonago to Daisen-ji.
water: Summit hut sells drinks in season.

points.name: Daisen-ji
points.note: The temple village at the foot of the mountain.

points.name: Misen
points.note: The 1,709 m summit of Daisen, on a boardwalk plateau.
